title: Phase 2 四视角 + MCTS 选题

phase_output.gap_id_policy: No prior-phase gap-ids are invented; candidate ideas use CONTEXT.three_questions identifiers Q1/Q2/Q3 as provisional gap targets and explicitly mark prior-phase linkage as missing.

candidate_ideas.title: Ontology failure-risk localization and protected-atom edit planner
candidate_ideas.gap_id_status: provisional: prior-phase gap-ids missing; Q1/Q2 are from CONTEXT.three_questions

falsifiable_claim.statement: For molecules flagged by A19 hasFailureRisk and A20 hasProtectedAtom, an ontology-grounded edit planner that emits ValidatedEditSequence and respects StereocenterAnchor will preserve end2edit_validity at 1.0 and anchor_violation at 0.0 while maintaining hardOK_48api ontology success at 0.875.
falsifiable_claim.falsification_condition: Falsified if any such edit has end2edit_validity below 1.0, anchor_violation above 0.0, or hardOK_48api ontology success below 0.875.

mechanism.statement: Use A19 hasFailureRisk, A20 hasProtectedAtom, A21 hasRequiredOperation SET_CHIRAL, ValidatedEditSequence, and the StereocenterAnchor contract to localize problematic structure and required operations.

data.statement: Use the provided corpus of 3272 CQ cases / 14 batches, 2783 crossdocked molecules, 3483 molecules, 79 evidence items, 5174 RL pool, and transforms_freed 5/5.

evaluation.statement: Evaluate against similarity and random baselines using hardOK_48api, exact sign test, end2end sign test, end2edit validity, and anchor violation.

transfer.statement: Transfer to the SynCraft edit-sequence setting and require evidence sufficiency because the CRUX lesson reports agents fail at evidence sufficiency.

mcts.rationale: Selected because it directly targets Q1/Q2 and has the strongest provided ontology evidence for hardOK, validity, and anchor safety.

candidate_ideas.title: Stereocenter-anchor contract validator for synthesizable analogues
candidate_ideas.gap_id_status: provisional: prior-phase gap-ids missing; Q3/Q1 are from CONTEXT.three_questions

falsifiable_claim.statement: If edits are validated by the StereocenterAnchor contract and StereocenterPreservingReaction class, then anchor_violation will remain 0.0 for ontology and ontology_lora and end2edit_validity will remain 1.0 for ontology and ontology_lora.
falsifiable_claim.falsification_condition: Falsified if anchor_violation is above 0.0 or end2edit_validity is below 1.0 for ontology or ontology_lora.

mechanism.statement: Use the StereocenterAnchor contract, StereocenterPreservingReaction, A20 hasProtectedAtom, and A21 hasRequiredOperation SET_CHIRAL to define which atoms and stereochemistry must not be touched.

data.statement: Use reasoner inferences from kernel_verify.json with owlrl 10400->23113 triples, plus the provided corpus and molecule counts.

evaluation.statement: Evaluate anchor preservation and edit validity against syncraft, ontology, and ontology_lora, with source fields noted as null.

transfer.statement: Transfer to structure-paired cases represented by the listed structure papers and to the SynCraft setting reported at similarity>0.6.

candidate_ideas.title: Crossdocked why-not explanation and edit benchmark
candidate_ideas.gap_id_status: provisional: prior-phase gap-ids missing; Q2/Q3 are from CONTEXT.three_questions

falsifiable_claim.statement: An ontology-grounded why-not explanation using A19 hasFailureRisk and A20 hasProtectedAtom will preserve anchor_violation at 0.0 and reproduce the reported end2end evidence of 7 wins 0 losses with exact sign test p=0.0078 when re-evaluated on the same provided artifacts.
falsifiable_claim.falsification_condition: Falsified if anchor_violation is above 0.0 or the end2end sign-test result is not 7 wins 0 losses with p=0.0078 on the same provided artifacts.

mechanism.statement: Generate a why-not explanation from A19 hasFailureRisk and A20 hasProtectedAtom, then edit with ValidatedEditSequence while preserving StereocenterAnchor.

data.statement: Use 2783 crossdocked molecules, 3272 CQ cases / 14 batches, 5174 RL pool, and transforms_freed 5/5.

evaluation.statement: Evaluate with hardOK_48api, exact sign test, end2end sign test, end2edit validity, and anchor violation.

transfer.statement: Transfer to open-ended agent research and SynCraft comparisons, with evidence sufficiency required because the CRUX lesson reports agents fail at evidence sufficiency.

selection_basis.criterion: ontology hardOK advantage over similarity and random

selected_reason.statement: IDEA_ALPHA is selected because it combines mechanism localization, data coverage, evaluation evidence, and transfer relevance with the strongest provided ontology metrics.
